summary: The main article describes a copper-catalyzed photoinduced decarboxylative alkynylation using redox-active esters and terminal alkynes. It includes 5 schemes detailing the reaction design, computational studies, substrate scope, and catalytic cycle, along with 2 tables for reaction optimization.

items.heading: Scheme 1
items.caption: (A) Sonogashira coupling; (B) photoinduced coupling of alkyl iodides via Cu-terpyridine acetylides; (C) decarboxylative alkynylation via Cu(Et3N)(acac) acetylides.
items.description: Compares the traditional Sonogashira coupling and previous photoinduced methods with the newly developed decarboxylative alkynylation approach.

items.heading: Scheme 2
items.caption: (A) Initial experimental test and (B) computational interpretation.
items.description: Shows the failure of initial conditions using terpyridine ligands and provides a computational explanation based on endergonic electron transfer.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Control experiments for decarboxylative alkynylation with aryl alkynes in 0.1 mmol scale
items.description: Optimization table screening various metal salts, ligands, and bases to identify the standard reaction conditions for aryl alkynes.

items.heading: Table 2
items.caption: Control experiments for decarboxylative alkynylation with non-aryl alkynes in 0.1 mmol scale
items.description: Optimization data for non-aryl alkynes, highlighting the necessity of copper-phenylacetylide as a photocatalyst.

items.heading: Scheme 3
items.caption: (A -C) Substrate scope of the decarboxylative alkynylation; (D) gram-scale reaction; (E) one-pot reaction.
items.description: Comprehensive display of the substrate scope including various redox-active esters and alkynes, as well as scalability and one-pot synthesis demonstrations.

items.heading: Scheme 4
items.caption: DFT calculations of the reaction pathways.
items.description: Detailed computational analysis of the reaction mechanism, including electron transfer, fragmentation, and the role of the acac ligand in preventing homo-coupling.

items.heading: Scheme 5
items.caption: The catalytic cycle for the copper-catalysed photoinduced decarboxylative alkynylation and the important role of NEt3 and acetylacetonate ligands in the reaction mechanism.
items.description: Proposed catalytic cycle illustrating the photoexcitation of copper acetylides and the subsequent radical coupling process.
